characters.description: En feig og ærekjær ridder som gjemmer seg når trollene kommer, og prøver å stjele æren for redningen ved trusler og løgn.
characters.look: A big, burly, barrel-chested knight of about forty, a head taller than most men, with a broad, puffy face that easily turns bright red, a big bulbous nose, small shifty pale-blue eyes under bushy brows, curly red hair and a huge, bushy fiery-red beard. characters.name: Kjerringa med ett øye
characters.description: Ei gammel, gammel, krokrygget kjerring med bare ett øye. Lillekort møter tre slike, og for å få øyet igjen gir de ham et sverd, et skip og kunsten å brygge.
characters.look: A tiny, ancient hag, no taller than a small child and bent double so that her back curves like a hook, with a small, deeply wrinkled face like a walnut, a flat little nose, a wide toothless mouth and only one eye: a single round, shiny sky-blue eye in the middle of her forehead. Her thin white hair is in a tiny knot. She wears a long, faded lavender homespun dress and a big brown fringed shawl, and leans on a crooked stick.

characters.name: Kongen
characters.description: Kongen på kongsgården ved havet, som har lovet bort den ene dattera til tre troll og mistet den andre til et troll i havet.
characters.look: A jolly, stocky king of about sixty with a big round belly, a broad, ruddy face made for laughing, a bulbous nose, crinkly brown eyes, bushy chestnut-brown eyebrows, thick chestnut curls and a big, round, curly chestnut-brown beard clipped short like a bush. characters.name: Kokkejenta
characters.description: Kokkejenta på kongsgården, som Lillekort bærer ved og vann for, og som får fang på fang med bånd av gull og sølv.
characters.look: A sturdy, cheerful kitchen maid of about eighteen with a broad, rosy, round face, merry dark-brown eyes, a snub nose dusted with flour and thick black hair wound into a bun under a white linen kerchief. Her sleeves are rolled up over strong arms. She wears a long cornflower-blue homespun dress and a big white apron with soup stains, and keeps a large wooden ladle tucked into her apron strings.

characters.name: Trollet med fem hoder
characters.description: Det første av de tre trollene som kongsdattera er lovet bort til. Det kommer farende over sjøen med fem hoder og ei tjukk jernstang.
characters.look: A huge, bloated sea troll about five times as tall as a man, with dusky purple-grey skin like an old mussel shell, crusted with barnacles and hung with strands of dark seaweed, a great sagging belly, long dangling arms and flat, webbed feet. It has exactly five heads on five thick, wrinkled necks, each with a long drooping nose, small round yellow eyes and a tuft of shaggy grey hair. It wears a kilt of old brown fishing net and carries a thick iron bar.

characters.name: Trollet med ti hoder
characters.description: Det andre trollet som kommer for å hente kongsdattera, dobbelt så stort som det første og med ti hoder.
characters.look: An enormous sea troll about ten times as tall as a man, with rough slate-blue skin, knobbly and shiny like wet rock, a broad, square body, short thick legs and huge webbed feet. It has exactly ten round heads in two rows of five, one row above the other, each with a flat nose, big goggling green eyes, a wide frog mouth and a scraggly grey beard. It wears a torn black sail wrapped around its middle and carries a huge iron bar.

characters.name: Trollet med femten hoder
characters.description: Det tredje og største trollet, med femten hoder og ei jernstang som får jorda til å sprute femten meter til værs.
characters.look: The biggest sea troll of all, as tall as a hill, with dark peat-brown, lumpy skin like a bog, shaggy grey hair on its shoulders, a round belly and legs like old tree stumps. It has exactly fifteen heads stacked in a pyramid, five on its shoulders, then four, three, two and one on top, each with a round red nose, small blinking amber eyes and a shock of grey hair. It wears a huge patched sailcloth tunic tied with a ship's rope and carries a gigantic iron bar.

characters.name: Trollet på havets bunn
characters.description: Trollet som har tatt den eldste kongsdattera med seg til berget på havets bunn. Det er så hissig og sint at det river folk i filler, men det vil gjerne ha sterkt øl til selskapet.
characters.look: A fat, savage-tempered troll about three times as tall as a man, with smooth, shiny turquoise skin like a wet fish, a barrel belly, short bowed legs and big flat webbed feet. He has one huge head with a gigantic, wrinkly, trumpet-shaped nose that is always sniffing, bulging pale-orange eyes, bristly orange eyebrows and a long tangle of brown kelp for hair and beard. He wears baggy patched sailcloth breeches held up by a rope and a necklace of big shells.

places.name: the Great Hall
